summary: BI-E22C3D75. Migration 20260923054500_customer_principal_auth_convergence projects every existing CustomerContact into the canonical Principal and PrincipalAlias spine before customer and social sessions begin enforcing Principal authorization. It creates no new source data: contact ids, lower-case emails, status, merge state, account status, and partner enrollment are re-used from existing customer-domain records. The migration is forward-only, set-based, and idempotent; it refuses case-folded duplicate emails or split alias ownership before any write. Runtime signup, linking, contact update, and merge paths maintain the same projection transactionally. A singleton aggregate view reports four invariant counts without exposing contact rows.

fields.name: displayName
fields.reason: The existing CustomerContact email is reused as the Principal display label. The migration collects no new value and does not make Principal the source of the email.
fields.provenance: CustomerContact.email on the same install-local customer party.

fieldPolicy.access: Available only through existing Principal and customer-account authorization surfaces; not added to any public projection by this change.
fieldPolicy.retention: Retained with the customer party and its canonical identity aliases under the existing domain lifecycle.
fieldPolicy.obligations: Use only to identify and administer the existing customer relationship. The email remains governed by CustomerContact and is not an authorization grant.

fields.name: kind
fields.reason: Derived discriminator: partner for a live partner enrollment, otherwise customer. It describes the platform identity population rather than adding subject data.
fields.provenance: PartnerProgramEnrollment.status and endedAt on the contact's CustomerAccount.

fields.name: status
fields.reason: Derived authority state. A contact is active only when the contact is active, not merged, and its account is session-capable; every other state projects inactive.

fields.name: aliasValue
fields.reason: Typed aliases join the Principal to the existing customer or partner contact id and lower-case email. They are identifiers for the same party, not a second profile or a new collection.
fields.provenance: CustomerContact.id and lower(CustomerContact.email); partner_contact is added only for a live PartnerProgramEnrollment.

fieldPolicy.access: Resolved inside the identity and authorization services under existing Principal access controls; aliases are not public directory entries.
fieldPolicy.retention: Retained with the canonical Principal so historical identity links remain attributable; superseded contacts project an inactive Principal.
fieldPolicy.obligations: Email is a convergence signal only after conflict preflight. Provider plus provider subject remains the social identity key, and ambiguous alias ownership must refuse.

changes.cleanupTest: The migration fixture drops its isolated PostgreSQL database after applying and reapplying the migration; the view owns no independent rows.
changes.reconciliationTest: packages/db/src/customer-principal-auth-convergence-migration.test.ts asserts the migration's conflict preflight and bounded four-count invariant view contract; populated migration smoke verified all counts at zero after repeat application.
